name: NDM-1

name: Cervical tumour drug response
question: Simulate how cervical tumour models respond to existing cancer drugs.
next: Run the starter in research/studies/cervical/ locally, then benchmark model predictions against independent published cervical organoid or cell-line response data with attributed inputs and a model held out.
